translations.description_clean:
!!! This is the Stellaris 2.1 version of this mod !!!
You can find 1.9 version [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=826432049]here
You can find 2.2 version [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1586639570]here (public beta)


The aim of this mod is to expand upon the vanilla technology tree of Stellaris with new tiers of weapons, shields, reactors, armor and thrusters. It also adds several new subtrees with technology based on crystals, psionics, gravity manipulation and Nanomachines. This mod adds:

Missiles and Torpedoes
- 2 extra tiers of basic Missile weapons.
- 2 extra tiers Swarmer Missile weapons.
- 2 extra tiers of explosive Torpedo weapons.
- Corrosive Warhead Torpedo as tier 6 explosive Torpedo weapon.
- Exotic Matter Warhead and Strange Matter Warhead as missile x-slot weapons.
- Reflex Warheads as titanic-slot missile weapon (Apocalypse DLC)

Energy Weapons
- 2 extra tiers Combat Laser.
- 2 extra tiers of Disruptor weapons.
- 2 extra tiers of Plasma Cannon weapons.
- 3 tiers of Plasma Missile weapons.
- 2 extra tiers of Energy Projectile Launchers.
- 2 extra tiers of Particle Lances.
- 2 extra tiers of Arc Emitters.
- Laser-based Point Defense System.
- Chrono-Vortex Cannon.
- Arc-en-Ciel Cannon (x-slot weapon or titanic-slot).
- Wave Motion Gun & Dimensional Wave Cannon (x-slot weapons)
- titanic-slot versions of Particle Lance, Arc Emitter and Wave Motion Gun (Apocalypse DLC)
- 2 extra tiers of Mining Drone Lasers.

Kinetic Weapons
- 2 extra tiers of Gauss Cannons.
- 2 extra tiers of Autocannons.
- 2 extra tiers of Kinetic Artillery.
- 2 extra tiers of Flak Artillery
- 2 extra tiers of X-slot cannon.
- MagnetoHydroDynamic Cannon as titanic slot (Apocalypse DLC)
- 2 extra tiers of Point Defense cannons.

Crystalline Weapons
- 5 tiers of regular crystalline cannons.
- 2 tiers of X-slot crystalline cannon.

Psionic Weapons
- 2 tiers of Psionic Energy Torpedo.
- 3 tiers of Psionic Beam Cannons.
- 2 tiers of Psionic Lances (no Apocalypse DLC).
- 1 x-slot and one titanic-slot Psionic Lance (Apocalypse DLC).
- Psionic strikecrafts.

Gravity Manipulation Weapons
- 3 tiers of Microsingularity cannons.
- 2 tiers of Microsingularity Warhead torpedoes.
- 2 tiers of Super-Graviton Cannons (no Apocalypse DLC).
- 1 x-slot and one titanic-slot Super-Graviton Cannons (Apocalypse DLC).
- Gravity-weapons-armed strikecrafts.

Nanomachine-based Components
- 3 tiers of Nanity Cannon.
- 2 tiers of Gray Goo Torpedo.
- 2 tiers of Nanite x-slot missiles (no Apocalypse DLC).
- 1 x-slot and one titanic-slot Nanite missiles (Apocalypse DLC).
- Nanite bomber strikecrafts.
- 2 tiers of Nanomaterial armor (auto-repairs hull and armor).
- 3 tiers of Shielding armor (armor that also generates shields).

Defense and Utility Components
- 2 extra tiers armor.
- 3 extra tiers of standard shields.
- 3 tiers of Cyclonic shields (faster regeneration at the cost of reduced toughness).
- 3 tiers of Citadel shields (greater toughness at the cost of slower regeneration).
- 2 extra tiers of thrusters.
- 3 extra tiers of sensors + Psionic sensors.
- 3 extra reactors.
- Repair drones (aux component).
- Improved Shield Capacitors (aux component).
- Crystal-Infused Shield Capacitors (aux component).
- Crystal-Forged Shield Capacitors (aux component).
- Standardized Warheads (aux component).
- Improved Amoeba and Swarm strikecrafts.

Other stuff
- Advanced planet-side power plants (2 tiers) (planet-unique).
- Advanced planet-side mineral mines (2 tiers) (planet-unique).
- 2 Empire-unique science building.
- Frontier Settlement, Frontier Farm, Frontier Mine and Frontier Power Station buildings.
- Neutronium Foundry building.
- Dark Matter Production building.
- Starfortress Reactor (starfortress building).
- Improved Dark Matter Reactor.
- Improved Dark Matter Shield.
- Improved Cloud Lightning weapons.
- Improved Auxiliary Fire control System component.

DLC bound content
- Enigmatic Energy Discharger (weapon) (Leviathans DLC)
- Enigmatic Energy Lash (weapon) (Leviathans DLC)
- Enigmatic Energy Autocannon (weapon) (Leviathans DLC)
- X-slot and titanic-slot Enigmatic Energy Lance (weapon) (Leviathans DLC)
- Dreadnough Protocols (combat computers) (Leviathans DLC)
- Nanomachine-Infused Dragonscale Armor (Leviathans DLC)
- Stellarite Power Core (aux Component) (requires Leviathans DLC).
- Hardlight Armor (armor + shield regen) (reuiqres Leviathans DLC).
- Stellar Energy Tower (building) (requires Leviathans DLC).
- Dimensional Horror Armor (armor) (requires Leviathans DLC).
- Extradimensional Spike (weapon) (requires Leviathans DLC).
- Quantum Computation Node (building) (requires Leviatans DLC).
- A.T. Field (requires shield) (Utopia DLC).
- Psi Reinforcement (aux component) (requires Utopia DLC).
- X and T slot Tiyanki Beam Cannons (requires Distant Stars DLC).
- Junk Mine Launcher (weapon) (requires Distant Stars DLC).
- Reprocessing Plant (building) (requires Distant Stars DLC).
- Voidspawn Missile (weapon) (requires Distant Stars DLC).
The mod should  work even if you don't have these DLCs, you just won't be able to get these components.

translations.description_clean:
Compatible with Stellaris 2.8. No longer updated, will remain as a legacy mod.

A sub-mod for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2451069015]Planetary Diversity 2.8, do not use without it, it needs to overwrite a small number of PD's files, so it should be placed below Planetary Diversity in your mod list.

[url=https://www.patreon.com/lexperegrine]https://i.imgur.com/diOwYyp.png

These are the main features:

[*]Adds a large number of new planets, both inhabitable and uninhabitable, with custom new textures.
[*]A script runs after game-start, to convert vanilla planets and resources, your game may seem to freeze, but this is normal and will only happen once per game.
[*]The Sol system has been updated to use some of the new planet classes, as well as updated textures for several planets, my version overwrites Planetary Diversity's and you can choose to make both Venus and Titan terraforming candidates, while Luna and Europa are candidates for underground colonization which is a new feature of this mod.


https://i.imgur.com/csLJPRf.png

All new planet textures and icons are original works and cannot be used without permission, while the other graphics may be recolors of Stellaris original assets.

https://i.imgur.com/Z8giP4O.png

This mod's new worlds would not be possible without Chris Adamek's contribution with his excellent texture-making! The mod is loosely based on his Star Trek Planet Classification Guide, adapted to better fit Stellaris. All textures are his original works, done specifically for this mod and for any other use he wishes to give them in the future. If you like his work and anything related to star trek, be sure to check out his website which also includes some fine fiction:

[url=http://www.sttff.net]Star Trek: The Final Frontier

Or his new website related to his original fiction, first book available on Amazon:

[url=https://www.starlight-universe.net/]Starlight Universe

Please rate this mod if you like it.

translations.title_en: Ideal System Locator (formerly Arc Furnace System Locator +)
translations.description_clean:
This mod was formerly named "Arc Furnace System Locator +".

Trouble figuring out the best system to build your kilostructures, stations, or branch offices in while playing Stellaris? This mod will help!

[url=https://www.paypal.com/ncp/payment/ELGMG24PFFSNA]Like this mod? Donate here!

Mod Effects:
Adds an "Ideal System Locator" decision to your capital planet once you've unlocked the ability to build one of the supported megastructures or starbase buildings. This creates an event pop-up with options to search for the following:

[*] Minor Megastructure Notification Settings: Options to enable notifications for when you build/upgrade a Hyper Relay, Arc Furnace, or Dyson Swarm
[*] Waystation: Up to 20 systems with the best value for a nomadic waystation, in a selection of total value, operational reserves, and best per resource.
[*] Branch Office: The top 5 colonies whose owner you have a commercial pact or federation with which will give you the most trade value from a branch office.
[*] Arc Furnace: The top 5 systems which will get the most deposits added if you build an Arc Furnace in them.
[*] Dyson Swarm: Up to 7 stars with the largest energy or research deposits for a Dyson Swarm, plus the star with the largest deposit of each other resource if you own a star with it. (Note: Due to scripting limitations, this function is only capable of evaluating deposits that exist in the base game. If you're running a mod that adds larger star deposits, it won't see them.)
[*] Central Habitat Complex: Up to 8 systems which will get the most districts of various types if you build a habitat in them. (Note: Due to scripting limitations, this function is only capable of evaluating deposits that exist in the base game. If you're running a mod that adds special orbital deposits, it won't see them.)
[*] Nanite Harvester: The top 5 systems which will get the most deposits added if you build a Nanite Harvester in them. (Note that this is not necessarily the same as the ones that will produce the most nanites/ships when they reach full potential.)
[*] Ice Mining Station: The top 5 systems which will support the most Expand Planetary Sea decisions if you build an Ice Mining Station in them.
[*] Quantum Catapult: The 5 systems closest to your capital that you can build a Quantum Catapult in.
[*] Pyroclastic Resonator: The top 5 systems which produce the most energy if you build a Pyroclastic Resonator in them.


Exactly which system is the best may still partially depend on what deposits they already have, but this makes finding your top contenders much easier.

 

This mod is a simple quality-of-life utility with no gameplay changes or script overwrites, so it should be compatible with all other mods (unless they change how any of these structures work). It can also be safely added to, or removed from, ongoing games.

This mod is not* achievement-compatible. *(At least not while enabled, but since it only evaluates systems without changing anything you can copy the save and load the game with the mod, check your systems, and then exit and reload with the mod disabled again if you're willing to fiddle with save files.)

All translations are MTL.
translations.title_zh_current: 理想星系定位器（Ideal System Locator）
translations.summary_zh_current: 帮你找出最适合建造巨型结构、空间站与贸易办事处的星系，大幅减少选址纠结。
translations.description_zh_current:
本 MOD（原名「Arc Furnace System Locator +」）是一款为选址发愁的玩家量身定制的 QoL 工具：解锁对应巨型结构或恒星基地建筑后，首都星球会出现「理想星系定位器」决议，弹出事件菜单帮你找出建造各种大型设施的最佳星系。
• 功能菜单：超空间中继/弧炉/戴森群的通知设置；游牧中转站（按总价值、运营储备、单项资源最优等维度最多列出 20 个星系）；贸易办事处（与你有商业协议或联邦关系的殖民地中，贸易收益最高的前 5 个）；弧炉（新增矿藏最多的前 5 个星系）；戴森群（能量/科研沉积最大的至多 7 颗恒星）；中央居住站复合体（区划潜力最高的至多 8 个星系）；纳米收割机、冰矿开采站（支撑「扩张行星海域」决议最多的前 5 个星系）、量子弹射器（距首都最近的 5 个可建造星系）、火成岩共振器（能量产出最高的前 5 个星系）。
